title: Amelia | Year-Round Layering Cardigan with Buttons
bodyHtml:
The cardigan you'll reach for every single day, no matter what the weather throws at you. Soft and skimming without clinging, it layers beautifully over your favourite pieces or works perfectly worn solo. Button-up or open, structured or relaxed—it just works, season after season, and makes any outfit feel instantly more polished.

Why you'll love it

  • Layering hero that works from cool mornings through to warm afternoons
  • Soft, breathable fabric that doesn't weigh you down, no matter how you style it
  • Button-front closure gives you structure and a put-together look in seconds, even over casual basics
  • Wear it open over anything, or button it up like a sweater—works with jeans, trousers, skirts and dresses
  • All-day comfort that feels as good at 9am as it does at 5pm
  • From everyday errands to nights out on the town, it's your go-to piece
  • Part of our exclusive 30-Year Anniversary Collection with strictly limited stock—once it's gone, it's gone

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
